title: listbox vs dropdown
rule: Dropdown to downplay alternatives / keep a default; listbox to expose options and encourage change.
pass_when: Dropdown is used to keep a default / downplay alternatives; listbox is used when options should stay visible and change is encouraged.
fail_when: Listbox hides alternatives that should stay visible, or a dropdown is used when the design needs to encourage changing the default.
